earlierAttempts.disposition: Reviewer script timing error. In Save a view, the script waited for a URL that already carried dir=asc from the earlier filter steps, so its Title clicks were out of step and the saved sort was not the one the script expected (sort read as null after reselecting the view). The script now starts the view steps on a clean /contracts address and waits for the column's aria-sort value. All other steps passed. Not an article or product failure.

Shared-lab data drift. Other agents added overdue Tasks for Daniel Okafor, so the reviewer's Task due one day earlier was not among the rows the Home card shows, and the find-your-work module stopped. The fixture Task now has a due date 400 days in the past. Search and settings modules passed in that attempt, including the corrected Save a view steps.

sanitization: No passwords, cookies, sign-in links, set-password tokens, authenticator secrets, backup codes or mail bodies are stored. Account passwords were generated in memory for each run.
